react.name: React

conventions.naming: PascalCase for components, camelCase for files

default_issues: Update React and dependencies to latest versions
Add TypeScript strict mode to improve type safety
Increase component test coverage
Document component API in README

next.js.name: Next.js

conventions.naming: PascalCase for React components, snake_case for utilities

default_issues: Upgrade Next.js to latest version
Migrate deprecated API patterns to new App Router
Add E2E tests with Playwright
Optimize Core Web Vitals metrics

express.name: Express.js
default_issues: Add comprehensive API integration tests
Document REST API endpoints with OpenAPI/Swagger
Implement request validation middleware
Add structured logging (winston or pino)

fastify.name: Fastify
default_issues: Implement comprehensive test suite with Tap
Add request validation with Fastify schemas
Document plugin architecture
Profile performance metrics

nestjs.name: NestJS

conventions.naming: PascalCase for classes, camelCase for methods

default_issues: Add comprehensive unit test coverage for services
Document module dependencies and architecture
Implement logging middleware across all modules
Add health checks and readiness probes for deployment

gin.name: Gin Web Framework

conventions.naming: PascalCase for exported, camelCase for unexported

default_issues: Add integration tests for all HTTP handlers
Implement middleware for request logging and validation
Document API endpoints with OpenAPI spec
Add graceful shutdown handling

grpc.name: gRPC

conventions.naming: snake_case for proto files, PascalCase for messages

default_issues: Generate and test all proto message serialization
Add service integration tests
Document protobuf message schemas
Implement reflection and health checks

fastapi.name: FastAPI

conventions.naming: snake_case for modules and functions, PascalCase for classes

default_issues: Add comprehensive test coverage with pytest
Document API with OpenAPI/Swagger UI
Add request validation and error handling
Implement background tasks and async processing

django.name: Django
default_issues: Add test coverage for views and models
Document models and API endpoints
Implement proper error handling and logging
Add database migration tests

flask.name: Flask
default_issues: Add pytest test suite with good coverage
Implement structured error handling
Document API endpoints
Add request validation with marshmallow or pydantic

axum.name: Axum Web Framework

conventions.naming: snake_case for modules, PascalCase for types

default_issues: Add comprehensive tests for all handlers
Implement error handling with proper status codes
Add OpenAPI/Swagger documentation
Optimize compile times with cargo features

tokio.name: Tokio Async Runtime
default_issues: Add benchmarks for async performance
Document concurrency patterns and limits
Add error recovery and timeout handling
Profile memory usage and CPU under load
